nextHour.rootCause: provider_data_rejected_summary_enum is thrown when summary.condition is outside the converter allowlist or lacks sufficient same-interval liquid-rain evidence; the old allowlist accepted only CLEAR and RAIN. The actual symbol in the supplied Tangshan response was not captured.
nextHour.conversion: DRIZZLE, HEAVY_RAIN, POSSIBLE_DRIZZLE can reduce to WK3 RAIN only when the summary/minute time boundaries align and the same interval has positive measured liquid intensity and probability; POSSIBLE_DRIZZLE without observed wet evidence rejects. CLEAR rejects when measurable/perceived wet amount exists. Unknown, snow, sleet, hail, mixed phase, multiple summary tokens, invalid timeline or missing numerics retain Apple original minute field.
nextHour.diagnosticHeader: X-WK3-NextHour-Diag WK3NH/4; stage, allowlisted symbol, wet/probability flags, summary/condition/minute counts, interval size, timeline result, coarse pattern; bounded and excludes coordinates, tokens and response body
